'''2012 Yavin 4 Regionals Matt Schmaltz LS Tatooine: Slave Quarters''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Matt Schmaltz]] at [[2012 Yavin 4 Regionals]] (Regionals).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Tatooine: Slave Quarters|Tat-L-tatooineslavequarters.gif}}
* '''Username:''' Dashmudtz
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Regionals
